title: Feature Analysis of Encrypted Malicious Traffic

value.name: CTU-13
value.quote: The CTU-13 dataset was captured as part of research project at the Czech Technical University. This dataset includes 13 malware traffic captures, consisting of both benign and malware traffic.

value.name: Malware Capture Facility Project
value.quote: The Malware Capture Facility Project dataset is from another research project carried out by the Czech Technical University ATG Group to capture, analyze, and publish real malware network traffic

datasets_evaluated.evidence: In this research, we have used the following two previously published network capture dataset, each of which contains both malicious and benign traffic.

label_source.evidence: The datasets from (Garcia et al., 2014) and (Erquiaga & Garcia, 2013) contains IP addresses of infected and benign hosts. We use these IP addresses to label our dataset.
